messages.subject: accessing  variables from function
parts:
Hello

I have a code that does some computation in a function.  I would like to use this in a plot which is another function.  For example in the following code

I would like to use fe in hist that is called in plotfe function.. Appreciate your inputs on how I could use it. 

predictfe <- function(){
   
      fe <- predict(earthmodel,dataframe())
      mean(fe)
      
      
    }  


plotfe <- function() {
    
    dataframe()
    
    output$feplot <- renderPlot( {
         
          PredictedFE = predictfe()
          hist(PredictedFE, col= c( "green","red"))
       
   ) }
